title: Unary block terminator
statement: For a Boolean list $x$ and natural numbers $k,n$, every $i$ with $k\le i<n$ has true entries at indices $2i$ and $2i+1$; the entries at indices $2n$ and $2n+1$ are respectively false and true. Out-of-range entries are treated as false.
hypotheses_covered: For every i with k≤i and i<n, entries at 2i and 2i+1 are true
